title: About MT Messe Stand
content:
Your Exhibition Stand Partner Since 2010

Your reliable partner for exhibition success in Turkey since 2010.

MT Messe Stand provides custom wooden, Octanorm, Maxima & modular exhibition stands. Turn-key service from design to dismantling worldwide. 300+ stands built across 28+ countries. We offer turn-key stand solutions — from custom wooden designs to modular Octanorm and Maxima systems — with a full range of exhibitor services under one roof.

300+ stands built across 28+ countries. Our clients include companies from Japan, China, Germany, Austria, Italy, Spain, Bulgaria, and Thailand. We bring international standards to every project.

Why MT?

  • Affordable: Cost-effective designs without compromising quality
  • Aesthetic: Stylish stands that represent your brand
  • Comprehensive: From design to dismantling, all from a single source
  • Dedicated Support: Every project gets a Junior Assistant-Mate on WhatsApp
